info.name: Solaris Zones Oracle Solaris Kernel Zones Archive Creation Zone Manager API
Solaris Zones List All Zone Management Interfaces

params.name: _rad_detail
params.description: When present, returns detailed property information for each interface or object in the response.

items.docs: Returns a list of all available zone management interfaces including ZoneManager, Zone instances, ZoneInfo, and migration connections. Use the _rad_detail query parameter to get full property details.

info.name: Solaris Zones Get the Zonemanager Singleton

params.name: _rad_detail
params.description: When present, returns detailed property information for each interface or object in the response.

items.docs: Returns the ZoneManager interface which provides system-wide zone management capabilities including zone creation, deletion, and evacuation state information.

info.name: Solaris Zones Create a New Zone

items.docs: Creates a new Solaris zone with the specified name, zone path, and optional template. The zone is created in the configured state and must be installed and booted separately.
Permanently deletes a zone from the system. The zone must be in the configured state before it can be deleted.
Import a zone configuration from zonecfg(8) format text, creating a new zone with the specified configuration.

info.name: Solaris Zones Create a New Zone

items.docs: Create a new zone with the specified name, zone path, and brand template. The zone is created in the configured state.
Delete an existing zone. The zone must be in the configured or installed state before it can be deleted.

info.name: Solaris Zones Create Ephemeral Zone Configuration

items.docs: Create a temporary zone configuration for editing before committing. Used for staged configuration changes.

info.name: Solaris Zones Import a Zone From Configuration

items.docs: Import a zone definition from an exported configuration. Used for restoring or cloning zone configurations.
Initialize evacuation of zones from the current host to a remote host. Must be called before evacuate(). Available since API version 1.4.

info.name: Solaris Zones Evacuate Zones to Remote Host

items.docs: Perform zone evacuation to a previously initialized remote host. Migrates all eligible zones. Available since API version 1.4.

info.name: Solaris Zones Cancel Zone Evacuation in Progress

items.docs: Cancel an ongoing zone evacuation operation. Available since API version 1.4.
